notes: Recorded 44 majors for the bachelor level: 8 in Social Sciences and Humanities A, 3 in Social Sciences and Humanities B, 19 in Natural Sciences A, 12 in Natural Sciences B and 2 in Natural Sciences C. This is the complete table in section 2 of the 2027 guidelines; the guidelines give no total.

The Others entries (Social Sciences and Humanities A item 8 and B item 3) are catch-all categories as the guidelines print them, not named majors. The guidelines warn that applicants who choose Others in course A may find it hard to get a university place.
Applicants choose up to three majors. In Natural Sciences the majors must come from the same course, except a first choice in Natural Sciences C may be followed by majors from B or C.

Majors are generic subjects, not university-specific programmes: MEXT assigns the national university. The universities and departments for direct placement are in a list the Japanese mission of each country supplies, which is not published in the guidelines.
The table is for the 2027 recruitment; MEXT revises it each year.
not_stated: The guidelines do not name universities per major, or the teaching language per major (classes are in Japanese except under direct placement at universities that need no Japanese).
fetch_problems: The country-specific lists of universities and departments for direct placement are issued by each Japanese mission and are not part of the central guidelines; none were read.
